scope: Public source provenance and author-selected derivation; no build, exhaustive dependency closure, independent audit or native qualification.

selected_engine.name: Upstream WebRTC native C++
selected_engine.selection_kind: immutable source baseline; rolling upstream, not release/binary certification
selected_engine.discovery: refs/heads/main resolved once, then immutable source URLs fetched
selected_engine.binding: Project-owned versioned bounded IPC from Rust adapter to native C++/Objective-C++ media helper; native WebRTC pointers and platform FFI remain inside helper
selected_engine.opus_upstream_provenance: 55513e81d8f606bd75d0ff773d2144e5f2a732f5 plus Chromium local changes; actual bytes pinned by third_party commit

source_claims.claim: Canonical native engine, exact commit and DEPS baseline; no binary qualification.
Engine and VP8/Opus source license/provenance terms; no complete distribution clearance.
Native factory, SDP/ICE/TURN and observer/resource API seams. Selected pin removes the old separate-worker factory overload.
Frame transform and encrypt/decrypt extension interfaces exist; they are not Talk E2EE or a guarantee of callback execution in the selected concrete path.
Decoder pool/resolution settings do not establish complete memory caps; VP8 native decode occurs before output pool allocation/copy; encoded images can allocate/reallocate.

Pinned libvpx has a CONFIG_SIZE_LIMIT guard before VP8 decoder initialization; configure exposes a size limit. Chromium generator/config use 16384x16384. External frame buffer API documents VP9-only support.
Talk internal-signaling settings/docs, concrete peer implementation and external HPB protocol; neither constitutes native released-profile interoperability evidence.
Talk key sessions/rotation and custom VP8/Opus frame encryption format require separate native work. T24/T25 key-management and frame-worker files have matching bytes.
Native alternatives: libdatachannel transport/C binding scope and external media processing examples; GStreamer peerconnection/RTP pipeline API.
Apple source queue has documented minimum/default three frames; CoreVideo allocation threshold is pool-specific, not an aggregate engine cap.

author_selected_allocation_contract.qualification: All media admission blocked pending before-allocation control of every required path. These ceilings are not process-footprint limits or measured budgets.

retrieval_notes: Google Gitiles sources were verified by direct HTTPS format=TEXT retrieval and base64 decoding; SHA-256 is over decoded raw file bytes.
The web tool could not open four Google Gitiles pinned pages; direct HTTPS retrieval succeeded. No web-tool error was treated as evidence.
Raw GitHub URLs identify official upstream repositories at immutable commits.
Apple documentation is mutable; exact retrieved JSON body hashes and UTC times identify snapshots, not immutable Apple releases.
Three attempted paths returned 404. They support no claims. The macOS arm64 config path was corrected by reading pinned BUILD.gn and fetching linux/arm64-highbd/vpx_config.h.
Retrieved extra files with no supports_claims entry are supplementary reads, not whole-file audits.
No upstream implementation source is proposed for repository inclusion. The source manifest can reproduce exact public snapshots.
limitations: No native allocation-hook implementation or exhaustive allocator-path proof
No inference that headers or a size guard cap all native allocations
No released Talk/HPB/TURN interoperability inference from research pins
No E2EE implementation or cryptographic dependency selection beyond engine hooks
No Mac SDK/device/capture/GPU/footprint or deadline evidence
No independent approval or PM gate acceptance

reproduction.gitiles: Fetch retrieval_url, base64-decode format=TEXT responses, then SHA-256 decoded bytes; commit JSON is hashed as received, including its anti-XSSI prefix.
reproduction.github: Fetch raw retrieval_url and SHA-256 response bytes.
reproduction.apple: Fetch JSON retrieval_url and compare response bytes with recorded hash; a later change is a new snapshot, not a refutation of the recorded one.
reproduction.arithmetic: docs/architecture/media-allocation.md section F; arbitrary-precision audit, not production overflow tests.
